name: annulus_mms_sym
description: Curved free-slip MMS for the sym form: annulus 1<r<2, Dirichlet r=1, slip r=2 (u.n = 0 and t.sigma_sym n = 0; the other form's tangential traction is non-zero). Variable mu. Needs isoparametric P2 geometry.

conventions.f: -div sigma_form - gamma grad div u (= -div sigma_form for these fields)
conventions.traction: g = sigma_form n, n the outward unit normal
conventions.grad_div: gamma (div u_h, div v); gamma in viscosity units, not scaled by mu
